sections.Profile:
"Lights...Camera...Action!" is a pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in December 1989. Part of the Gottlieb System 3 series, it features a film production theme with three flippers, one ramp, and a three-ball multiball. Designed by Jon Norris, with artwork by Constantino and Jeanine Mitchell, it combines alphanumeric displays and engaging sound effects for an immersive experience. Only 1,708 units were produced.
